chronology: Contract and literal fixture/expected bodies retained before candidate source intake; private author drafting predates the freeze. This source/observer binding follows candidate intake and completed author execution, before independent invocation.
ordinary_import_review: CLI resolves its own source root, seats exact checkout package and imports real package_reader and renderer. Exact original __init__, app_paths, registry, settings_store and reader remain unchanged. Constructors that write appdata are not called; no fake Path or import shim.

source_boundary.output: Existing parent; outside source package; os.path.lexists refusal followed by exclusive xb/write/length/flush/fsync/context-close. No atomic snapshot, durability or race matrix inference.
source_boundary.escaping: Full ensure_ascii=False JSON dictionaries escaped as text. Gaps are exactly dataclasses.asdict of the unchanged seven-field GapSummary. No inference of chronology, alignment, duration, repair, integrity, raw-gap or complete capture.
source_boundary.standalone: Inline style, restrictive CSP, no script/resource nodes. Full recorded values in open details/pre blocks; native local navigation.
source_boundary.omissions: Missing/unsupported/filtering unknowns and normalized gap projection limits are explicit. Recovered state is reader-reported metadata.
source_boundary.presentation: Light/dark/print CSS reviewed in source; one later ordinary display is planned. No duration or separate open/closed aggregate displayed, so conditional oracle fields are not presented as executed display requirements.

post_intake_observer_selectors.records: pre[data-kind] in checkpoints, annotations, sync-anchors, gaps; data-index binds supplied list order
post_intake_observer_selectors.metadata: dt/dd label values parsed with Python json

author_evidence.first_cross_exec_staging_refusal: Retained by author; stopped before candidate source materialization, import or execution. Not a product failure.

independent_execution.transport: One live custody process retains private /dev through exact export; no cross-exec persistence assumption.
independent_execution.mac: Research metadata interval released; Mac report receiving remains pending a fresh guard. No CaptureSuite application import on Mac.
